text:
mike: Quick sync — ACME health POC. Need to lock success criteria, model/context choice, and answers for their security questionnaire. Can we decide by EOD tomorrow?

sara: I can run the criteria meeting. Who's owning the security Q? Also need a short list of models we recommend.

priya: I’ll take the security questionnaire. Need clarification on KMS, logs retention, and whether PHI will be sent to hosted API or Private.

ian: Short thoughts on model tradeoffs:
- 32k context model covers long patient notes but increases per-token cost and memory; good for single-pass summarization.
- Alternative: use 8k/16k model + retrieval over embeddings (chunk notes) + reranker — cheaper and often similar accuracy.

esther: For retrieval pipeline: embeddings -> ANN -> reranker. Recommend embeddings index (dense) + small reranker model as a toolcall for precision on medical entities. Redwood can host rerankers as a separate route.

mike: @priya FYI they require tool-calling to an internal PHI-redaction API before generation. That implies Private deployment or VPC peering. @sec-bot can you confirm blocking items?

sec-bot: sec-bot: Preliminary flag: PHI in-flight & at-rest requirements, BA needed, KMS integration required, audit logs retention 7 years requested in questionnaire. Also request for vulnerability scan report.

priya: Good to know. I’ll ask the customer for BA template and infra diagram. Can we support AWS KMS and customer-managed keys in Private?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Redwood Private supports customer KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and on-prem HSM gateways. Need config task: set up key alias and role.

ian: For success metrics we should propose concrete evals. Example prompt and metrics below — share to ACME for signoff.

```
system: You are a concise medical summarizer restricted to the customer KB. Do NOT hallucinate.
user: "Patient note: [long clinical note chunk]. Summarize key diagnosis, meds, and next steps."

Metrics:
- Precision@1 (top answer medically correct) >= 0.85
- Reranker P@1 >= 0.9 on gold set
- Embedding recall@100 >= 0.95 for retrieval
- Latency: p95 <= 500ms cold, <= 150ms warm; tail under 1s
- Cost: baseline token-cost per 1k tokens vs chunked retrieval baseline (attach estimate)
```

esther: For datasets: we need ~500 labeled QA pairs + 200 rerank triples for a first POC eval. That’s small and feasible in 2 weeks with ACME SMEs.

mike: Pricing Qs from the customer: how much more for a 32k model vs 16k? Also how does dedicated capacity pricing look for predictable throughput?

sara: Sales estimate: 32k variants typically ~2.5-3x per-token compute vs 8k/16k. Dedicated nodes pricing depends on committed qps; I’ll draft a baseline: small dedicated pool for POC (2 GPUs) + burst config.

priya: Also flag enterprise blocker: their procurement needs SOC2 + HIPAA addendum and a contractual SLA. We have templates but need legal loop.

mike: Action items:
- priya: fill security questionnaire & request BA template (due tomorrow EOD)
- ian & esther: propose two model pipelines (32k single-pass vs 16k+retrieval) with perf/cost estimates (due EOD tomorrow)
- sara: prepare committed capacity rough pricing and timeline for integrating Private (due EOD)
- mike: sync with ACME PM to get SMEs for 2-week eval dataset collection

priya: noted. I’ll ping them now for infra diagram and BA.

ian: Will attach a quick perf sketch and cost back-of-envelope to this thread when done.

esther: I can mock the reranker toolcall API signature so sec and infra can review payload shapes (small JSON sample).

mike: Thanks everyone — if we hit these, we can get signoff and run the 2-week eval. Marking owner comments in the doc.

sara: +1. Quick check-in tomorrow 10am PT?

mike: 10am PT works.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket POC-ACME-147; owners assigned.
